name: Pawfectly Nourished
description: Pet-nutrition subscription service selling personalised meal plans for dogs and cats through its own website, built around a library of 78 recipes, with plans starting at $19 and recurring billing.

evidence.summary: Pawfectly Nourished's official affiliates page offers tiered 8-18% commission on every subscription referred, paid recurring on every renewal 'forever, not just the first month', with a 90-day cookie, no minimum traffic requirement and free joining, and states verbatim: 'Earn 8-18% commission on every subscription you refer. No cap, ever.'

The same page explicitly recruits pet influencers (Instagram, TikTok and YouTube pet creators), pet bloggers, video creators, newsletter publishers and vets/trainers, supplies banner packs, social media kits, email swipe copy and a demo video, and reviews most applications within 48 hours.

The page's own stats describe a small, early-stage service: a library of 78 recipes, plans starting at $19 and 2 species supported. No creator counts, sponsored-post counts or network creator totals were found on any fetched page, so creator saturation could NOT be evidenced as low and is recorded as unknown.

opportunity.title: Pawfectly Nourished Affiliate Program (8-18% recurring, no cap)

reasons.niche_fit: Pet nutrition subscriptions for dogs and cats are a core pet-UGC topic, and the program is built for pet creators on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured affiliate program explicitly recruiting pet influencers and video creators, with ready-made social media kits and demo video assets.
reasons.compensation: Tiered 8-18% commission that recurs on every subscription renewal for the life of the customer, with an explicit 'No cap, ever' statement on the brand's own page.
reasons.contact_access: A public application form on the official program page with a 48-hour review promise, but no published partnerships email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join today with no minimum traffic requirement, so even very small creators can apply.
reasons.credibility: Small, early-stage subscription service with its program terms published in full on its own site, but little independent coverage so far.

evidence.summary: CyberLink's official affiliate page states verbatim: 'Earn UNLIMITED commissions on the sales you make', 'Make up to 30% in UNLIMITED commissions from your sales' and 'Earn up to 30% in uncapped commissions with 90-day cookie tracking even when your audience downloads the free version!' Sign-up routes through CJ Affiliate (signup.cj.com).

The same page invites promoters to push products 'on your website, blog, YouTube channel, or social media', provides an all-in-one marketing kit (referral links, product shots, logos) and offers featured placement on CyberLink's own social channels for partners. No creator counts were published on any fetched page, so creator saturation is recorded as unknown.

opportunity.title: CyberLink Affiliate Program (up to 30%, uncapped, via CJ Affiliate)

reasons.niche_fit: PowerDirector is video-editing software - the tool category creators themselves use daily - so it fits tech and creator-economy UGC unusually well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official program that names YouTube channels and social media as promotion routes and supplies a full marketing kit, though it is a general affiliate program rather than a creator-only one.
reasons.compensation: Up to 30% commission with commissions explicitly stated as unlimited/uncapped on the brand's own page, plus a long 90-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: A public sign-up route via CJ Affiliate from the official page, but no published partnerships email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free open sign-up today through CJ Affiliate with a quick online application.
reasons.credibility: Long-established, award-winning software publisher ('some of the world's most awarded multimedia software') with global distribution.

name: Castlery
description: Direct-to-consumer furniture brand selling modern sofas, tables, beds and home decor online, with a curated catalog and delivery and warranty support, operating affiliate programs in the US, Australia and Singapore.

evidence.summary: Castlery's official US affiliate page says affiliates earn a competitive commission on every qualified purchase across all products with a minimum 30-day tracking window, and states verbatim: 'The more you sell, the more you make. AffTank's furniture-program guide lists Castlery at a tiered 5-8% commission with a 30-day cookie via ShareASale, scaling with referred volume (InfluencerRate publishes the same tier table: 5% up to $5,000/month rising to 8% over $15,000/month).

impact.com's case study reports Castlery migrated its affiliate program to impact.com, recruited over 300 global partners and grew quarterly US orders 5X with a 12% AOV increase - an established, actively managed program. Partner counts are not creator-saturation counts, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

opportunity.title: Castlery Affiliate Program (tiered 5-8%, no-cap performance bonuses)

reasons.niche_fit: Modern furniture and home decor with high order values is a staple home-UGC category, and the program welcomes social-media promotion.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The official page targets media partners, content sites and networks and supports website, newsletter and social promotion, but publishes no creator-specific program layer.
reasons.compensation: Tiered 5-8% commission (recorded at the 8% top tier) with performance bonuses through higher rates that the brand's own page says have no cap.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through the affiliate networks from the official page; no published partnerships email was found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live and joinable now in the US, Australia and Singapore.
reasons.credibility: Established digital-first furniture brand with a documented impact.com case study and hundreds of recruited partners.
